positive.prompt: Turn these interview, observation, and policy notes into source-linked candidate requirements and play them back to the authorized stakeholders
Synthesize the evidence into goals, workflows, rules, constraints, quality attributes, and concrete examples while preserving disagreements
Record which requirements were validated, approved, rejected, or contested and who had authority for each decision

negative.prompt: Plan neutral interviews and observation, map missing stakeholder roles, and capture what each source actually said
Write the actor goal as a black-box main success scenario with alternate and failure flows

evals.prompt: Review every file under evidence/ and playback/. Create discovery/requirements-brief.md. Synthesize source-linked goals, workflow, rules, constraints, examples, and open decisions; apply validation or approval only where the playback role has the documented authority. Preserve disagreement and leave any unauthorized retention value unresolved. Stop before software design or implementation planning.
evals.expected_output: A sanitized requirements discovery brief with provenance, revision-specific validation and approval, concrete examples, unresolved conflicts, and downstream requirements handoffs.
expectations: The dashboard request remains distinguishable from the reconciliation outcome
Every material requirement links to supporting or contradicting source evidence IDs
Validation and approval reflect the authority declared in playback
The unresolved retention question remains open without an invented value
prohibitions: Do not erase rejected or conflicting evidence
Do not invent approval, dates, thresholds, or retention rules
Do not choose software architecture or implementation tasks
